topSignals.headline: Bloom Energy Q2 2026 BLOWOUT: $1.065B revenue (+165% YoY), first $1B quarter - stock +11.2% AH
topSignals.summary: BE posted record Q2 2026 results after market close. Revenue: $1.065B vs. $827.02M consensus (+29% beat). Adj. EPS: $0.78 vs. $0.41 estimate (+90% beat). Product revenue: $935.4M (+215% YoY). Gross margin: 33.4% (+668bp from Q2'25's 26.7%). Operating income: $182.2M (vs. -$3.5M in Q2'25). FY2026 guidance raised to $3.9-4.2B (from $3.4-3.8B, $500M raise at midpoint), adj. EPS $2.55-$2.85, ~34% gross margin, $800-900M non-GAAP operating income. KR Sridhar: 'All major US hyperscalers and over a dozen neoclouds, AI labs, and colos have validated and approved our power solutions for their AI factories.' BE +11.2% AH (~$205 open).

topSignals.headline: FERC RM26-4 August 17 RTO/ISO filing deadline - 20 days out
topSignals.summary: The June 18 Section 206 show-cause orders against all six RTOs/ISOs (PJM, MISO, SPP, CAISO, ISO-NE, NYISO) require tariff reform filings by August 17. Outcome determines whether self-supply exemptions (analogous to ERCOT Batch Zero's $5-20/MWh avoided transmission cost benefit) can be extended to other regions and thus become modelable inputs in non-ERCOT LCOE scenarios. ISO-NE abeyance request due first: August 3.

topSignals.headline: Oracle Project Jupiter: NM senators escalate opposition to revised air permit
topSignals.summary: Four Democratic NM senators gathered in Las Cruces (late July 2026) to formally oppose the Bloom-SOFC-only revised air quality permit application (filed July 15), calling on the NM Environment Department to deny it outright. Substantive hearing: October 19; final decision deadline: November 23. Gas supply route still dead after second NM Land Commissioner pipeline rejection (July 20). Two blockers: (a) gas pipeline access and (b) air permit. SemiAnalysis first-power base case: 2029. Oracle maintains project on schedule.

sections.name: Stack & Cell Technology
bullets: Elcogen: No new announcements July 28. EFCF 2026 proceedings remain under embargo (day 25+). E3000 G2 deliveries ongoing; ELCO I factory (360 MW/yr, Tallinn) in volume production.

Topsoe: No new SOFC/SOEC announcements today. Herning SOEC factory remains hibernated (440 jobs, 500 MW/yr on ice). Project Starling (120 MW SOEC, UK e-SAF, construction 2028, first operations 2031) active. SOFC data center pathway deferred to 2029+ per H2 access timeline.

Ceres Power (LON: CWR): No new announcements. Down ~37% month-to-date. Delta Electronics Taiwan factory (Ceres-licensed, NT$6.95B, end-2026 production launch target) and Doosan Gunsan (80% yield vs. 90% target) unchanged. H1 2026 results (September) next catalyst.

sections.name: AI Data Center Deployments
bullets: Bloom Energy: all major US hyperscalers + 12+ neoclouds/AI labs/colos validated. KR Sridhar Q2 call confirms broadest commercial validation to date. Oracle 2.8 GW MSA (April 2026), AEP 1 GW 20-yr offtake ($2.65B, Jan 2026), $7.65B in DC contracts in 90 days (Q1 2026). Fremont 2 GW/yr ramp; Q2 product revenue $935.4M annualizes to ~$3.7B.

Oracle Project Jupiter (2.45 GW): NM senators on record opposing air permit. Gas pipeline attempt 3 or federal easement needed. Hearing October 19, decision November 23. SemiAnalysis: 2029 first power. Oracle maintains schedule.

Active pipeline (unchanged): Crusoe/Cheyenne 900 MW Phase 1 (H2 2026), FCEL/Fit Energy 30+350 MW option, Equinix 100+ MW, AEP/Bloom Wyoming 1 GW (2030), Bloom/Brookfield $25B framework, Nebius/IDF/Oaktree $1.7B, EdgeMode Malpica 300 MW Spain, DayOne Singapore 20 MW H2-SOFC trial, Taiwan Topco (May 2026).

sections.name: Regulations & Policy
bullets: FERC RM26-4: 20 days to August 17. Six RTOs/ISOs must file. ISO-NE abeyance due August 3. Self-supply exemption scope = key non-ERCOT LCOE input.
NERC August 3 questionnaire: 33 reporting questions for computational loads, enforcement deferred to 2027. No new developments.

NM Project Jupiter political opposition: Senator opposition formally on record, escalating beyond environmental group objections. Project Jupiter 2.45 GW SOFC demand signal at higher-than-modeled execution risk.

sections.name: Competing On-Site Power
bullets: Quiet day. Background unchanged: Microsoft Project Kilby (2.67 GW CCGT, Texas, 2028), DOE AP1000 nuclear loan programme (2030+), Google Meitner Energy Center (wind/solar, TX), three DOE microreactors critical by July 4 (non-dispatchable before 2030). Bloom Q2 gross margin 33.4% and +11% AH reinforces SOFC economic case vs. competing on-site power.

lcoe.flag: UPDATE REQUIRED - Capex pathway revision from BE Q2 product margin 33.4%
lcoe.detail: Gross margin improved +668bp YoY at 2 GW Fremont scale. Interim: update LCOE model SOFC capex low-end from $6,000/kW toward $5,000-5,500/kW if product margin confirms ongoing decline. Do not move base case until shipped MW confirmed from transcript (1-2 business days).

lcoe.flag: BE FY2026 implied annual production: 3-4 GW at current guidance midpoint
lcoe.detail: Fremont rated 2 GW/yr. If shipment guidance implies >2 GW in 2026, external supply chain or EaaS/service revenue recognition is inflating product revenue. Reconcile with transcript shipped MW data.

All 12 analyst price targets exceeded the pre-earnings $184.89 close. Expect 3-5 target raises and possible Buy upgrades in the next 48-72 hours. New consensus targets will inform SOFC market cost of capital proxy for LCOE discount rate sensitivity.
If 500 MW converts by 2028, adds a second commercial SOFC platform. FCEL capex structurally higher than BE due to smaller scale; monitor Torrington output costs as expansion completes.
Filing scope determines whether $5-20/MWh avoided transmission cost can be modeled in PJM, MISO, CAISO, and ISO-NE LCOE scenarios - the four largest non-ERCOT DC markets.

Political opposition escalation + gas pipeline dead-end increases probability that Oracle's 2.45 GW SOFC demand signal does not materialize on 2026-2027 timeline. Recommend adding a 'Jupiter delayed to 2029' scenario in the LCOE pipeline model, reducing 2026-2027 installed GW assumptions by 0.5-1.0 GW.
